title: x402-buyer-verification: buyer-side verification of x402 v2 payments on Base
description:
Supplementary dataset for three pre-registered buyer-side experiments verifying x402 v2 payments on Base mainnet, executed as scripted protocol runs and committed regardless of outcome; every reported number traces to a committed analysis.json and raw artifacts under experiments/.

Experiment 1: echo-verify

A fresh USD 0.01 mainnet happy-path settlement, verified end-to-end via payer-anchored Transfer events on two independent RPCs (paid run 1.11 s; discovery median 0.0388 s over 15 GETs; tx 0xa3143d32319392227c017ce86dceb2a8e377b7e4f32c21f2693a6925e91f201c).

  • Headline finding: exactly 0.01 USDC settled to payTo per Transfer events on both RPCs.

Experiment 2: mock-seller

Hostile-seller failure-mode detection, including a same-nonce EIP-3009 replay on an Anvil fork pinned at block 54035433.

  • Headline finding: 4 of 4 hostile-seller failure modes were correctly detected; the replay reverted at EVM state level with FiatTokenV2: authorization is used or canceled.

Experiment 3: preflight-external

Decode-only compatibility probing of third-party x402 endpoints, with a hard no-payment guard: zero payment-bearing headers sent, guard trips on 0 paid requests.

  • Headline finding: 2 of 3 third-party endpoints returned protocol-compatible v2 402 challenges; agent402.tools diverged with a 404.

Contents

  • experiments/ — pre-registered protocols, runners, run records, verbatim raw API artifacts and on-chain receipts
  • results/, RESULTS.md, METHODOLOGY.md, DATA_DICTIONARY.md — per-experiment reports, record schema
  • figures/, recipe/ — frozen figure recipes and rendered figures

Disclosure: the operator is affiliated with aptu.dev; Experiment 1 verifies the operator's own endpoint. Findings are about verification of the x402 protocol, not any product.
